info.title: Xerin API Documentation
info.description:
API documentation for Driver, Customer, Partner, and Admin endpoints.

- Customer and Driver paths are prefixed with `/api/` (Laravel API routes).
- Partner paths are under `/api/partner/v1/`.
- Admin paths are web routes served directly under the domain.

tags.name: Partner
tags.description: Partner Delivery API - external systems create delivery orders, get quotes, track status, and receive webhooks
